==Forums==
The contents of the three largest forums, "[[BPFK: Old Meta-BPFK Forum|Meta-BPFK]]" (April-September 2003),  "[[BPFK: Old General Negators|General Negators]]" (April-August, 2003), and "[[BPFK: Modal Aspects|Modal Aspects]]" (June-July, 2003) have been extracted from the SQL data and reformatted for wiki.
